176.text: The day saw several conversations unfold between the residents. Ana attempted romance with Bram, while Cy endured being shot, later stealing a rifle from the armory that night. Old Odo's passing was noted, and the group had designated the east hill Widow's Rest. During a speech, Dee asserted, Enough. We eat because the structure holds, and the structure holds.

184.text: The snow started falling while the sky darkened. We made a name for the east hill, calling it Widow's Rest. It's good to keep things ordered, even with the chill setting in. We buried one of the old members today.

186.text: Rat bit me today. Spoke with Dee again. Finished the metal thing. Ate at the meal and the party afterward.

193.text: The snow came down. The sky went dark for a while. Someone died in the yard and the body needs digging up. The kitchen seemed busy today, even with the new visitors.
